Films of HfO2 were deposited onto a Si(100) substrate using a horizontal quartz hot-wall type ALD reactor, as shown in Fig. 1. HfCl4 was evaporated at 433 K and introduced into the growth zone with purified N2 as a carrier gas. Oxidation was carried out using O2, which was introduced into the deposition zone with purified N2 as well.
